sentences.text: 1. 1. This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners as well as learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.
Perused the records.

3. This is an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioners for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Sections 420,406, 294, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

4. Being aggrieved by order dated 28.11.2024 passed in BLAPL No.2299 of 2024 by the learned 3rd Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar, the Petitioners have approached this Court by filing the present application under section 438 Cr.P.C.
5.
Mr. Mund, learned senior counsel appearing for the Petitioners that although the 3rd Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar has allowed the anticipatory bail application vide order dated 28.11.2024.

Further, he has directed the Petitioners to surrender before the learned S.D.J.M.,
Bhubaneswar and to go on bail.
Learned counsel for the Petitioners at this juncture further contended that the Petitioner No.1 is a cancer patient and bed ridden.
So far Petitioner No.2 is concerned, she is a house wife.

Further referring to the allegations made in the F.I.R., learned counsel for the Petitioners submitted that the informant has lodged the present F.I.R. implicating the present Petitioners and the principal accused, who happens to be the son of Petitioner No.1 and ) Basir Khan vs ) State Of Odisha .....

1 husband of Petitioner No.2.
Learned counsel for the Petitioners also submitted that the Petitioners have nothing to do with the present case, however they have been implicated at the instance of the informant.
6. Taking into consideration the seriousness and gravity of the offence and the role played by the Petitioners in the present crime, this Court is inclined to allow this application.

Accordingly, It is directed that in the event of arrest of the Petitioners by the Arresting Officer in connection with Capital P.S.Case No.449 of 2024 corresponding to C.T.Case No.1644 of 2024 pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Bhubaneswar, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as would be deemed just and proper by the Arresting Officer.
7. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.

8. Issue urgent certified copy of this order as per Rules.
( ADITYA KUMAR MOHAPATRA) JUDGE RKS Location: High Court of Orissa )
